workspace.pendingGuideNote: The team checks each response before completing the request. Delivery and scope decisions stay in their source records.

hub.toolsNote: One workspace for analysis, reviewed actions and content. Choose a tool to begin; opening it does not generate anything.
hub.clientNote: Describe the name, email and business details. Review the draft and enter the portal password before creating the client.
hub.projectNote: Turn a description into an editable project draft. Dates and identifiers are only filled when provided.
hub.tasksNote: Create or replan tasks using authorized project information.
hub.taskPrompt: Help me create or plan tasks. First identify the available projects and missing information.
hub.summaryNote: Review progress, risks and next steps with source records.
hub.summaryPrompt: Summarize progress, risks and next steps using the available project sources. Identify missing information.
hub.contentNote: Attach files to discuss their content, draft text, or use /image followed by a description to generate an image. This tool does not execute workspace actions.
hub.noCredentials: Do not include passwords or sensitive credentials in the description. Enter the portal password only during review.
hub.passwordNote: Enter a portal password with at least 8 characters. It is used only for the reviewed registration, not sent to the model.
hub.generateError: Could not prepare a valid draft. Include the required information and try again.
hub.saveError: Could not save. Check the fields and your permissions before trying again.
hub.historyNote: Content conversations are saved in this browser for your user. Contextual actions above are stored by the organization and checked against your current access.
hub.weeklyNote: Generate the existing weekly report. Leave both dates empty for the default period, or provide both dates.
hub.insightsNote: Review the existing risk and priority indicators. They are planning indicators, not guarantees or probabilities.
hub.localHistoryOnly: Changes apply to content conversations saved in this browser only. Workspace records and server executions remain available.
hub.clearConfirm: Delete all content conversations from this browser?
